question: Ricky Kej won his third Grammy award in 2023 for which of the following albums?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Divine Tides.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ricky Kej **won his **third Grammy award **in **2023** for the album **"Divine Tides".**
 
• "Divine Tides" is a collaborative album between Ricky Kej and several other artists, including** Lonnie Park, Wouter Kellerman**, and others.
 
• Ricky Kej's previous Grammy wins were for his albums **"Winds of Samsara" (2015) **and** "Ballad of Maya" (2019).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Winds of Samsara"** is a collaboration between** Ricky Kej **and South African flutist **Wouter Kellerman,** and features a fusion of Indian classical **music and African rhythms.**
 
• **"Ballad of Maya" **is a concept album that explores the themes of** love, loss, and reincarnation **through the story of a woman named Maya.
 
• At the UN General Assembly in October 2023, Kej was named a **UN "Goodwill Ambassador" (UNCCD)**.
 
 
• Kej was selected as **GQ Hero 2020 by GQ magazine**, and he was crowned **GQ "Man of the Year" **in **2023.**
 
• He represents the** Earth Day Network** as an ambassador.
